meta.name: Dexter: Pecado Original
meta.description: En 1991, Miami. Dexter Morgan pasa de ser estudiante a ser un asesino en serie vengador, ya que sus impulsos sanguinarios no pueden ignorarse y debe aprender a canalizar su oscuridad interior. Un desafío particular para el joven Dexter, que comienza una pasantía forense en el Departamento de Policía Metropolitana de Miami.

videos.title: Y al principio...
videos.overview: El joven Dexter Morgan lucha por controlar sus impulsos mientras vive la vida con su padre, Harry, y su hermana, Deb, estudiante de último año de secundaria. Después de que Harry tiene un problema de salud, Dexter se da cuenta de que finalmente puede ser el momento de cumplir su destino.

videos.title: Kid in a Candy Store
videos.overview: Dexter adjusts to his new job as a forensics intern at Miami Metro, as Harry returns to work after his medical leave. Deb lashes out at her dad by engaging in petty criminal behavior.

videos.title: Miami Vice
videos.overview: Dexter goes after a loan shark with ties to Batista, as Harry is told to keep an eye on Maria Laguerta, Miami Metro's newest homicide detective. Deb throws a party to win the favor of her volleyball teammates.

videos.title: Fender Bender
videos.overview: Dexter targets a retired mob hitman (who may still be killing), as Harry works the gruesome murder case of a 10-year-old boy. Deb sneaks into a nightclub with Sofia and meets an exciting new friend.

videos.title: F Is for Fuck-Up
videos.overview: After a kill goes wrong, Dexter is grounded by Harry. Deb deepens her relationship with Gio, and bonds with her brother on the anniversary of their mother's death.

videos.title: The Joy of Killing
videos.overview: Miami Metro is shaken by a kidnapping that hits close to home, as Dexter sets his sights on a killer that slipped through the cracks of the justice system. But first, Dexter must survive a double date with Deb and her new boyfriend.

videos.title: The Big Bad Body Problem
videos.overview: Dexter needs to find a new hiding place after his most recent dumping ground is blown. Harry and LaGuerta pitch a controversial theory to Spencer, as the hunt for a missing child continues. Deb gets in trouble for an outburst in volleyball practice.

videos.title: Business and Pleasure
videos.overview: Deb sneaks away for a trip with her mysterious boyfriend. Dexter is tasked with finding her. Harry and LaGuerta travel to Tampa to look into a potential serial killer on the loose, while Miami Metro closes in on suspects in the child kidnapping.

videos.title: Blood Drive
videos.overview: In the fallout of a SWAT raid gone wrong, Dexter closes in on the child kidnapper. Meanwhile, Deb goes to work with her Dad... and sees Miami Metro in a new light. Harry digs deeper into the serial killer case but keeps his theory from LaGuerta.

videos.title: Code Blues
videos.overview: Dexter races to find the missing kidnapped child before it's too late. Deb visits her godfather in the hospital and rethinks her future. Harry comes face-to-face with a serial killer... leading to a shocking result.

videos.overview: Welcome to Dexter: Final Cut! The official after show for Dexter: Original Sin. The journey has begun, and we’re slicing into every chilling detail! Hosted by Jamie Chung and featuring special guest executive producer Scott Reynolds, Episode 1 dives deep into the Dexter universe with exclusive insights, on-set secrets, and plenty of surprises. ???? From dissecting twists to spilling behind-the-scenes tea, this episode is a must-watch for every Dexter superfan. Plus, fun games and insider stories you won’t find anywhere else!

Alex Shimizu joins Jamie to discuss stepping into the role of young Vince Masuka in Dexter: Original Sin. ???????? From behind-the-scenes stories to perfecting Masuka’s iconic laugh, Alex shares what it’s like to bring the fan-favorite forensics expert to life. Get ready for laughs, lab talk, and all things Masuka!

videos.title: Final Cut: Jamie Chung & C.S. Lee
videos.overview: This week, Jamie Chung and guest C.S. Lee (the OG Masuka!) break down Episode 9: Blood Drive—and it’s a wild ride. From Brian Moser’s bone-chilling origin story to Harry’s shocking demotion and Spencer’s kill room callbacks, they connect the dots between past and present Dexter chaos. Plus, C.S. Lee reveals the advice he gave Alex Shimizu on nailing Masuka’s iconic spirit. Dexter: Original Sin is heating up, and the season finale is just around the corner! Be sure to check out the latest episode of Dexter: Original Sin only on Paramount+ with Showtime!

videos.title: Final Cut: Jamie Chung & C.S. Lee
videos.overview:
The wait is over! In the season finale of Final Cut, we’re diving headfirst into the electrifying conclusion of Dexter: Original Sin Episode 10: Code Blues. From shocking twists to jaw-dropping callbacks, this episode ties it all together in classic Dexter fashion.

We’re also welcoming back C.S. Lee, the one and only OG Masuka, for a deeper dive into his time on the original series, behind-the-scenes stories, and how the legacy of Vince Masuka still lives on in this new chapter. It’s the perfect blend of nostalgia and new chaos. Get your final fix of all the Dexter fun,and catch Dexter: Original Sin streaming now—only on Paramount+ with Showtime.
